digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary 'Success Criteria/Acceptance Criteria' in reviewer prompts and routing index creates ambiguity where the rubrics treat them as equivalent, necessitating consolidation to a single term

All occurrences of 'success criteria/criterion' must be renamed to 'acceptance criteria/criterion' across reviewer prompts and routing index, except at deliberately excluded sites (T2.md generic trial metrics, verifier definition-of-done wording)
The generated criteria guide must be regenerated from the updated registry to eliminate success criteria vocabulary while preserving T2's excluded phrase
Registry version must be rotated when criteria_routing.json is edited, invalidating outstanding attestations, which is safe only after grandfathering (ADR 0053) has merged
Bare tokens 'SC' in G3.md ('THREE SC-CONTRADICTION PATTERNS' and 'SC says zero matches') must be manually replaced with 'AC' equivalents to avoid matching unrelated 'O-RAN-SC' patterns
Acceptance criteria verification must confirm all in-scope renames are complete, the guide regenerates with exactly one SC match (from T2), and registry_version rotation is captured at runtime
